 About the Contributors 
 Jayden Randolph , Photo Editor 
 Jayden Randolph is a junior studying public relations and psychology. She has been a staff photographer with the Beacon since her freshman year, and is excited to hold an editorial position this upcoming year! Jayden is an aspiring sports photographer and hopes to work for the MLB or NFL in the future. She is passionate about visual storytelling and loves using photography to express her creativity. Outside of the Beacon, Jayden enjoys music, weightlifting, baseball games, a really good spicy chicken sandwich, and being sarcastic.
